title: Contract-to-Perm Handoff and Evaluation Criteria — Technical Roles (Draft)
content:
Purpose and context:
This doc captures a repeatable playbook for evaluating contractors for conversion to full-time engineers (IC2+/IC3). Focus: technical ICs on serving-runtime, infra, and platform teams. Goal: reduce bias, speed decisioning, and ensure handoff clarity between Eng, People Ops, and Hiring Manager.

Summary of flow (high level):
- 60-day check-in (informal): manager & peer feedback, deliverable review.
- 90-day formal review: rubric-based scoring across 5 domains + conversion recommendation.
- Decision window: conversion yes/no/extend probation with reasons and remediation plan.
- Onboarding handoff: if converted, transition to full-time onboarding slate (payroll, equity briefing, benefits enrollment, mentor assignment).

Quick notes (working):
- This is intended primarily for roles that started as 6- to 12-month contractors with potential to convert.
- We recommend conversion decisions be made no later than day 95 to avoid payroll complications.
- For federal contractors or regulated projects, sync with Legal before any offer. (See linked artifacts)

Evaluation rubric — core domains (score each 1-5; 5=exceeds, 3=meets, 1=insufficient). Add short evidence bullet for each domain.
1) Problem solving & technical correctness
   - Evidence: PRs, bug fixes, architecture notes, postmortems.
2) Code quality & craft
   - Evidence: code review thread samples, static analysis results, test coverage notes.
3) System design & scaling judgment
   - Evidence: design docs, perf tuning work, load test outcomes.
4) Collaboration & communication
   - Evidence: cross-team syncs, docs, async updates, conflict handling examples.
5) Ownership & delivery reliability
   - Evidence: on-time delivery, follow-through on action items, triage participation.

Conversion scoring guidance (working thresholds):
- Strong convert: avg >=4.0 and no domain <3.
- Conditional convert: avg between 3.2–4.0 or one domain with 2 but strong remediation plan agreed with manager & People Ops.
- Do not convert: avg <3.2 or any domain =1 with unresolved blockers.

Decision participants and sign-off matrix:
- Hiring manager: primary recommendation + evidence summary (required).
- Peer reviewers (2): at least one from within team + one cross-functional reviewer (optional for small teams).
- People Ops partner: confirms policy compliance, compensation banding, and equity eligibility.
- Finance approval: required for headcount/budget impact if conversion adds headcount to org plan.
- Legal: required if contract had special terms or NDAs.

Artifacts to attach to the conversion packet (one doc upload to candidate folder):
- Manager recommendation memo (300–600 words)
- Completed rubric with evidence bullets
- Selected PR excerpts (links) + one representative code review thread
- 60- and 90-day check-in notes
- Compensation recommendation sheet (People Ops)

Onboarding / first 30-60-90 checklist post-conversion (short):
- Day 0: offer accepted -> payroll set up, background check confirmation, benefits enrollment sent, equity paperwork queued.
- Week 1: full-time orientation invite, team intro meeting, mentor assignment (see mentor rotation below), badge/access updates.
- Month 1: career ladder calibration meeting, first 1:1 growth plan draft, pair programming goal set.
- Month 2: impact presentation to team (what changed after conversion), align on next 6 months goals.

Mentor rotation and buddy slate (practical):
- Assign 1 primary mentor (technical lead) + 1 onboarding buddy (IC peer). Buddy rotates on 6-week cycles; mentor is stable for 90 days.
- Mentor responsibilities: codebase tour, PR review guidance twice weekly for first month, run a 30-min design deep-dive session by week 3.
- Buddy responsibilities: daily async check-ins first 2 weeks, onboarding hacks, doc pointers.

Risk log / common failure modes (notes to self):
- Work mismatch: contractor excelled at tactical tasks but lacks system-level judgment — mitigation: extend probation 45 days with focused design tasks and mentor pairing.
- Hiring manager bias toward availability rather than fit — mitigation: require at least 2 peer reviews and People Ops calibration.
- Contract legal constraints causing delay — mitigation: Legal triage as soon as conversion is discussed (pre day 80).

Templates (copy-and-paste snippets)
- Manager rec template:
  "Recommendation: Convert / Conditional / Do not convert
   Summary (3–4 bullets): candidate strengths, gaps, key examples
   Proposed plan (if conditional): remediation tasks, milestones, owner, timeline"

- Candidate message (offer/decision brief):
  "Thanks for your work on X over the contract term. After review we would like to [offer convert / continue contract / end term]. Next steps: People Ops will send official docs within 48 hours. Your manager will schedule a sync to cover transition details."

Open questions (to resolve before finalizing policy):
- Exact numeric thresholds for small sample sizes (single reviewer scenarios).
- Equity eligibility cutoff for conversions <6 months — current legal guidance suggests minimum tenure; confirm with Compensation.
- Standardized peer reviewer guidance doc — should we create a 1-page reviewer cheat-sheet? (yes).

Operational notes and playbook tasks (short backlog):
- People Ops: draft reviewer cheat-sheet (owner: Dana) — due 2026-01-15.
- Eng managers: pilot this rubric with two contractor-to-perm cases in Q1 2026.
- SRE/Infra exception flow: create a lighter process for on-call critical contractors.

Appendix: example evidence snippets (pasteable)
- PR sample line: "fix: reduce memory allocation in KV cache by switching to contiguous buffers — decreased 95p latency from 280ms to 180ms in canary"
- Design note excerpt: "Proposal: route-based cache invalidation with per-route TTLs; trade-offs: staleness vs throughput; expected throughput improvement 12–18%"

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally conversational/draft. Look for gaps that will create friction (legal, finance, manager load). If you have contractor conversion this quarter, add anonymized notes beneath the 90-day section so we can calibrate thresholds.

---
Recent edits log (tracking within doc):

- 2025-12-18: first-pass mentor rotation schedule added (Miguel)
- 2026-01-08: updated artifacts list and decision matrix (Dana)

TODOs before turning into policy:

- Build reviewer cheat-sheet + sample evidence pack (2 examples per domain)

End of draft.
